purpose: Place the three unchanged authored lesson source files in one exclusive ordinary owned delivery directory, then invoke the exact existing RecallWeave parser once on the physical saved JSON. This is separate from the independently owned SQLite qualification and any future learner use.

original_parser.transport: The original complete ESM bytes are imported through a data URL. No export stripping, source substitution or function reimplementation.

fixed_delivery.new_parent_admission: The prior intake did not test this parent for writes. The separately reviewed stage checks ordinary UID1000, existing nonsymlink real home directory owned by that UID, writable/searchable access, absence of the exact new target, and successful exclusive mkdir before any file write.
fixed_delivery.final_record_order: The marker is written last only after one successful physical parser call and exact source/runtime preservation checks.
fixed_delivery.file_write_semantics: Exclusive xb create; write/flush/fsync/close; then mode0444. Physical file existence/identities are measured if actually executed. No power-loss/reboot or directory-fsync durability guarantee.
fixed_delivery.failure: Any refusal/failure stops the one attempt and retains created partial files without cleanup or reuse. No second staging or parser call is admitted by this proposal.

actual_runtime_intake.runtime_body_limit: Executable sha256/git_blob values are actual native-computed identities; binary bodies were not exported or uploaded. Node shared-library closure was outside that metadata intake.
actual_runtime_intake.destination_limit: The intake only read statvfs('/home/jacob'); this source separately checks the existing parent and exclusive new target before creating anything.

runtime_qualification_scope: The /usr/bin/node ELF wrapper and /usr/bin/python3 executable identities are pinned to the actual receipt, including bytes, SHA256, computed Git ID, mode, mtime_ns, inode, device and resolved path. Node22.22.1 was observed by the separate metadata version child. The complete Node shared-library closure, full Python stdlib and OS runtime were not qualified by that intake. This stage rechecks only the two selected executable identities and actual parser-child Node version.

preserved_original_targets.source_semantics_target: SQLite3.50.4, unchanged in the original authored sources
preserved_original_targets.observed_SQLite_metadata: SQLite3.46.1 is metadata from the separate actual intake; this stage imports no sqlite3 module, creates no database and executes no statement.
preserved_original_targets.independent_SQL_scope: Control owns its distinct fileless SQL receiver/proposal. Its actual reviewed closure is a root prerequisite, not an output produced by this stage.

guide_delivery_context.disclosure_location: The final DELIVERY.json records the original repository context and exact pinned source URLs. These identify source, not an installed/running app. No extra application/launcher/layout files are copied to make those relative links appear locally available.

resource_plan.helper_reuse: Complete text_file, optional_value and resources bodies are byte-for-byte copied with aliases for existing globals; exact helper and inverse proof are retained in the delta.
fresh_checks: immediately before the single parser child
resource_plan.memory_definition: Minimum of current MemAvailable and every readable finite memory.max/memory.high headroom over the same single unified cgroup-v2 path through all visible ancestors. Unexpected/hybrid mount layout or incomplete paired controls refuse; no alternate permission/path fallback.
resource_plan.own_cap_scope: Logical file bytes in the unique four-file target. Directory metadata/allocation granularity and process RSS are not claimed as hard-capped by this source.
resource_plan.original_outer_limit: As in the prior accepted staging approach, the program disables its alarm before final receipt serialization/write. The actual matching external tool runtime must also be <=20 seconds; exit0 or the pre-output elapsed field alone is insufficient.
resource_plan.stream_limit_scope: The fixed trusted child uses communicate with an eight-second timeout and a post-capture stream length check; this is not a streaming memory limiter.
